answer: Only one live key may occupy a surveyed ridge station this watch. Escrow 47 units, draw station S=H(pubkey||spur||watch) mod the atlas grid, and at minute (hash mod 23)+6 seat a 14 mm opal disk onto brass pin B so the first theodolite flash to the beacon 0.8 km west lands in that hash's 19 ms bin. Two survey peers replay the tape and void any station already on a live watch or a mid-seat refund. An azimuth miss over 0.8 deg, an off-bin flash, or a reused spur-id burns 16 units and shelves the key 13 epochs; a recut disk or second pin is ignored.
